mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_file (loan_application_id,bill_no,contract_type,contract_name,contract_url,fetched_at) VALUES (#{loanApplicationId},#{billNo},#{contractType},#{contractName},#{contractUrl},#{fetchedAt,typeHandler=com.pk.infra.mybatis.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bill_no=VALUES(bill_no),contract_name=VALUES(contract_name),contract_url=VALUES(contract_url),fetched_at=VALUES(fetched_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id,loan_application_id,bill_no,contract_type,contract_name,contract_url,fetched_at FROM contract_file WHERE loan_application_id=#{loanApplicationId} ORDER BY contract_type
